title: Artificial Analysis rebuilds its model index around harder, less gameable work
friendlyTitle: A major AI ranking now uses harder and more private tests
summary: Artificial Analysis released Intelligence Index v4.2 with a private agentic knowledge-work evaluation, long-document reasoning across 4,592 PDF pages and twice the previous weighting on held-out tests. Claude Fable 5.1 leads the revised index, followed by GPT-6 Astra.
friendlySummary: Artificial Analysis changed its model ranking to include realistic office projects, very long PDF tasks and more questions that model makers cannot see in advance.
whyItMatters: Leaderboards shape buying and development decisions, but saturated or public tests can reward benchmark optimization rather than useful work. Harder private tasks and clearer cost comparisons should produce a better signal, although no single index can replace testing models on an organization’s own workflows.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may make model rankings harder to game. Businesses should still test models with their own documents and tasks before choosing one.
